purpose: Bind a representative, solution-neutral capability set for GEN-CREATIVE-01 while reusing the existing zero-model creative preference packet and avoiding premature discovery, execution, Skill authoring, or standards extraction.

scenarioBinding.task: Co-create several materially different directions from an incomplete brief, preserve the creator's intent and rights, and let the human make the final aesthetic and value decision.
scenarioBinding.authorityBoundary: Draft and critique only; publication, purchase, rights transfer, or destructive asset edits require separate authority.
scenarioBinding.dataBoundary: User-provided brief and licensed or explicitly permitted references only.

staticCapabilities: opens a Creative Production review board before production
defaults to four to six distinct visual directions when appropriate
may use image-generation and external design integrations when available
lifecycleAndAuthorityCosts: declares a bundled Node MCP server
board writes, image generation, integrations, and external account boundaries require task-specific preflight
license and host portability differ from a portable open Skill

conditionalGrillingObservation.staticValue: One decision question at a time, recommended answers, environment lookup for facts, and explicit human ownership of decisions.
conditionalGrillingObservation.conditionalUse: Only when consequential brief decisions are genuinely missing and the user explicitly wants deep stress-testing; do not convert intentionally open aesthetic preferences into mandatory intake closure.

excludedNearMatchObservations.reason: Its mandatory project-context, design-approval, specification, review, and implementation-planning lifecycle is software-development specific and would add unrelated ceremony and writes to this creative-direction scenario.

The current source remains a broad root Skill, media and design dependency tree, direction gates, and optional blocking Hook; no independently attributable lower-cost component is exposed for GEN-CREATIVE-01.

representativeAlternatives.role: Low-structure baseline for several labelled directions, factual brief preservation, and explicit return of aesthetic choice to the human.
openEvidence: candidate behavior under the fixed packet

representativeAlternatives.role: Current official visual-production candidate inside its board, MCP, account, data, write, and license boundaries.
openEvidence: blind diversity, intent fidelity, rights traceability, and edit burden

representativeAlternatives.role: Explicit, proportional composition only when unresolved consequential brief decisions block safe production.
openEvidence: whether deep intake reduces material correction without suppressing useful ambiguity
composition fidelity across the intake-to-production boundary

representativeAlternatives.role: Human-only control and fallback for final aesthetic and value judgment, creator intent, reference permission, and publication authority.
openEvidence: independence sufficient for a useful control arm

comparisonDecision.reason: The bound set spans native, official, proportional composition, and human-control routes, while the existing packet already supplies the deterministic boundary oracle. Additional names or another equivalent fixture would not prove behavior, rights traceability, or reduced human burden.
comparisonDecision.nextBoundedAction: Use the existing packet as the deterministic gate for any later source-pinned candidate output, then require a separately authorized live exposure preflight and blind human review before any value, admission, default-route, or standard claim.

neutralityAndJudgmentBoundary.neutralityRule: Do not privilege a route because it is native, official, popular, installed, self-authored, or familiar; compare it against the bound scenario and evidence surface.
neutralityAndJudgmentBoundary.subjectiveJudgmentTreatment: Aesthetic and value judgments are legitimate human inputs and outcomes, not noise to erase. Record their owner, context, uncertainty, and review method; do not silently promote them to universal facts.
